assertion: After the reader repair, derived_share on the UNFCCC workbook is 0.226 against a threshold of 0.20 registered before the file was opened.

error.magnitude: bounded below by SSS_017's residual: any formula construct still unread lowers the numerator, so 0.226 is a floor and not a two-sided estimate

domain_of_validity.outside_this: UNTESTED. The threshold was registered for a class of workbook described as live calculators, and one member of that class has been measured.

clock.holds_for: as long as the file and reader are unchanged

collapse_record.basis: a ratio of two exact counts, 825 over 3656
